name: sgemm_lora_b
description: Segmented LoRA-B projection with a residual base. x is [S, r], weights is [num_lora, N, r], and base_output is [S, N]. For each segment b with adapter w = weight_indices[b], if lora_ranks[w] is nonzero, out[rows] = base_output[rows] + scalings[w] * (x[rows] @ weights[w].T), accumulated in float32 and cast to base_output.dtype; permutation, when present, selects the output rows. Empty segments and zero-rank adapters are skipped. Returns a newly allocated [S, N] tensor; base_output is read only. Suites exercise bfloat16 tensors and int32 batch metadata.
